judged_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:25-27) injects a literal 'refresh_token' placeholder string when the field is missing, and it is persisted over the user's real refresh token in the DB (office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:263 and zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:104), irrecoverably destroying the credential — later local refresh sends the string 'refresh_token' to the provider and the integration is permanently dead.

adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` explicitly mutates the parsed token object: if `refresh_token` is missing it sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts). In office365calendar, the returned safeParse result is merged into the existing credential object with the parsed data spread last: `{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), which will overwrite an existing valid `refresh_token` with the literal placeholder when providers omit `refresh_token` on refresh. That updated object is then persisted via `prisma.credential.update`, effectively destroying the stored refresh token for future refreshes.
